properties.title: Offshore substation AF08
properties.description: One of two offshore substations BOEM lists for Revolution Wind, collecting power from the turbine strings before export to shore.

properties.title: Offshore substation AL11
properties.description: The second of two offshore substations BOEM lists for Revolution Wind, linked to substation AF08 by an inter-substation cable before combined export to shore.

properties.title: Export cable to Quonset Point
properties.description: One of two parallel 275kV export circuits BOEM lists running from offshore substation AF08 to the Quonset Point landfall. Route simplified from BOEM's official survey path (889 vertices) for map display; the true corridor also includes a near-identical second circuit.

properties.title: Inter-substation cable
properties.description: The link between Revolution Wind's two offshore substations, per BOEM's official export-cable GIS data. Route simplified from the official survey path (291 vertices) for map display.

properties.title: Quonset Point cable landfall
properties.description: Where Revolution Wind's export cables come ashore, per BOEM's official offshore landings GIS data. From here the cables run roughly a mile underground to a newly built substation.
